title: On transcendence of non-periodic continued fractions associated with modular forms and arithmetic functions
summary: The purpose of this article is two-folds. Firstly, we establish two sufficient conditions under which the sequence $\{f(n)\pmod{m}: n\geq1\}$ is non-periodic, where $f(n)$ is an arithmetic function. As consequences, we deduce that the sequences associated with the Ramanujan tau function $τ(n)$ as well as the Fourier coefficients of certain normalized Eisenstein series $E_k(z)$ modulo $m$ are non-periodic.
